---
title: "Gray Pre-Cancer Atlas: sequence-level filtering"
author: "Jenny Li"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: paper
    toc: true
    toc_float:
      collapsed: false
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
params:
  dir: "filter"                      # {dir}/{caller}/sequence.csv + sequence_removed.csv (absolute path when rendering)
  callers: "mutect2_no_pon,vardict"
  min_ad_snv: 5
  min_ad_indel: 10
  strand_min: 0.1
---

```{r setup, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 4.5)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(knitr)

CALLERS <- trimws(strsplit(params$callers, ",")[[1]])
num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
read_caller <- function(file) bind_rows(lapply(CALLERS, function(cl) {
  d <- fread(file.path(params$dir, cl, file), colClasses = "character", na.strings = NULL)
  d$caller <- cl
  d
})) %>% mutate(caller = factor(caller, levels = CALLERS))

kept <- read_caller("sequence.csv") %>%
  mutate(depth = num(Sample.Depth), alt_depth = num(Sample.AltDepth), vaf = alt_depth / depth,
         fwd = num(Sample.AltFwd), rev = num(Sample.AltRev), fwd_frac = fwd / (fwd + rev),
         class = ifelse(nchar(REF) == nchar(ALT), "SNV / MNV", "indel"))
removed <- read_caller("sequence_removed.csv")
STEPS <- sort(unique(removed$removed_at))
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 12))
pct <- function(x) round(100 * x, 1)
```

Rows = one call (sample + variant) from one caller. Steps remove rows; `pass_minad` and `pass_strand` only flag them.

# Rows removed at each step

```{r funnel}
n_removed <- removed %>% count(caller, step = removed_at) %>% complete(caller, step = STEPS, fill = list(n = 0))
n_input <- bind_rows(count(kept, caller), count(removed, caller)) %>% count(caller, wt = n, name = "input")
funnel <- n_removed %>% arrange(caller, step) %>% left_join(n_input, by = "caller") %>%
  group_by(caller) %>%
  mutate(rows_left = input - cumsum(n), pct_of_input_removed = pct(n / input)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(caller, step, removed = n, pct_of_input_removed, rows_left, input)
kable(funnel, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))

ggplot(funnel, aes(step, removed, fill = caller)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "rows removed", fill = NULL)
```

# Flags on the rows that are left

```{r flags}
kept %>% group_by(caller, class) %>%
  summarise(rows = n(),
            pct_pass_minad = pct(mean(pass_minad == "TRUE")),
            pct_pass_strand = pct(mean(pass_strand == "TRUE")),
            pct_strand_NA = pct(mean(pass_strand == "NA")),
            pct_pass_both = pct(mean(pass_minad == "TRUE" & pass_strand == "TRUE")),
            pct_FILTER_PASS = pct(mean(FILTER == "PASS")), .groups = "drop") %>%
  kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","))

kept %>% count(caller, pass_minad, pass_strand) %>%
  group_by(caller) %>% mutate(pct = pct(n / sum(n))) %>% ungroup() %>%
  kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

# Alt depth

Dashed lines = `pass_minad` cutoffs (`r params$min_ad_snv` SNV / MNV, `r params$min_ad_indel` indel).

```{r alt-depth, fig.height=5}
cuts <- data.frame(class = c("SNV / MNV", "indel"), cut = c(params$min_ad_snv, params$min_ad_indel))
ggplot(filter(kept, alt_depth > 0), aes(alt_depth, fill = pass_minad)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60) +
  geom_vline(data = cuts, aes(xintercept = cut), linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_grid(caller ~ class, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "grey45", "FALSE" = "#D95F0E")) +
  labs(x = "alt depth", y = "rows")
```

```{r alt-depth-low}
kept %>% filter(alt_depth <= 20) %>% count(caller, class, alt_depth) %>%
  ggplot(aes(alt_depth, n, fill = class)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~caller, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(x = "alt depth (<= 20)", y = "rows", fill = NULL)
```

# Strand

Alt forward fraction = `Sample.AltFwd` / (AltFwd + AltRev); dashed lines = `r params$strand_min` and `r 1 - params$strand_min`.

```{r strand}
if (any(!is.na(kept$fwd_frac))) {
  ggplot(filter(kept, !is.na(fwd_frac)), aes(fwd_frac, fill = pass_strand)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(params$strand_min, 1 - params$strand_min), linetype = "dashed") +
    facet_wrap(~caller, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "grey45", "FALSE" = "#D95F0E", "NA" = "grey80")) +
    labs(x = "alt forward fraction", y = "rows")
} else cat("No strand counts in these files (re-parse needed).")
```

```{r strand-vaf}
if (any(!is.na(kept$fwd_frac))) {
  kept %>% filter(pass_strand != "NA") %>%
    mutate(vaf_bin = cut(vaf, c(0, 0.01, 0.05, 0.35, 1), include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
    group_by(caller, vaf_bin) %>%
    summarise(rows = n(), pct_fail_strand = pct(mean(pass_strand == "FALSE")),
              pct_fail_minad = pct(mean(pass_minad == "FALSE")), .groups = "drop") %>%
    kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
}
```

# Depth and VAF

```{r depth-vaf, fig.height=6}
kept %>% select(caller, Depth = depth, VAF = vaf) %>%
  pivot_longer(-caller, names_to = "measure") %>% filter(value > 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(value, colour = caller)) +
  geom_density(linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~measure, ncol = 1, scales = "free") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "density", colour = NULL)
```

# Caller FILTER tags

```{r tags, fig.height=6}
tags <- kept %>% select(caller, FILTER) %>%
  mutate(tag = strsplit(FILTER, ";")) %>% unnest(tag) %>%
  count(caller, tag) %>% left_join(count(kept, caller, name = "rows"), by = "caller") %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / rows)
ggplot(tags, aes(pct, reorder(tag, pct))) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~caller, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "% of rows carrying the tag", y = NULL)
```

# Per sample

```{r per-sample}
kept %>% group_by(caller, Sample.ID) %>%
  summarise(rows = n(), pass_both = sum(pass_minad == "TRUE" & pass_strand == "TRUE"), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(c(rows, pass_both)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(name, value, fill = caller)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.6) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "rows per sample", fill = NULL)
```
